title: MATRIX_LR increase at DEPTH=10
description: Changed MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06 at DEPTH=10 (Muon LR for matrix params), testing whether the MATRIX_LR=0.06 win seen at depth=8 (round 0) stacks with the new depth=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.005623, worse than the 1.002530 baseline (MATRIX_LR=0.04). The MATRIX_LR=0.06 gain observed at DEPTH=8 does not transfer to DEPTH=10 -- likely because Muon LR isn't auto-scaled by model width in setup_optimizer (unlike the AdamW LRs), so the optimal MATRIX_LR is probably a function of model_dim and needs to be re-tuned per depth rather than assumed to compose. This makes a0's proposal (#18, sweeping MATRIX_LR at depth=10, trying 0.05) more informative than mine -- worth checking if a lower value near 0.04-0.05 is better, or if MATRIX_LR should decrease as depth/width increases.
